text:
Sam Patel: Quick design review request — updated Error Inspector mock in Figma: <https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/error-inspector|Error Inspector v3>. Looking for quick thumbs on: stack trace grouping, correlation ID copy, export behaviour, and keyboard nav.

Maya Chen: skimmed — overall :thumbsup:. Main concern: stack traces feel too dense, need clearer grouping by exception type. Maybe have a collapsible header per exception with count.

Arjun Gupta: For collapse behavior, do we do client-side collapse (fast) or server-side grouping (accurate counts)? Client-side ok with current payloads, but if we want pre-aggregated counts we need server grouping.

Jordan Lee: A11y nit: the collapse controls need aria-expanded + visible focus ring. Contrast on the "Copy correlation ID" button is borderline (WCAG AA fail at 2.5:1).

Maya Chen: Good call. Suggest copy button be inline text button with icon, label "Copy ID" (not just icon), and tooltip "Copied!" for feedback. Also put it next to the timestamp.

Lila Park: On export: ops asked for sanitized CSV by default + an option for full JSON export. Can we add a primary dropdown: Export ▾ -> CSV (sanitized) / JSON (full) / Raw events?

Sam Patel: Yes — default CSV sanitized. Also want a "copy link" action that encodes filters so you can share a permalink to this drilldown.

Arjun Gupta: Implementation note: permalink should be short; we can encode the filter state server-side and return a short id. Will add endpoint /drill/shorten. Also will wire CSV sanitization as server option.

Maya Chen: Microcopy tweak: header "Request details" -> "Request trace & metadata" (makes clearer we include both stack and headers). Move correlation ID up near timestamp.

Jordan Lee: Keyboard flow: tabbing through trace frames should land on the frame title, then the expand button, then the copy link — ensure DOM order matches visual order for screen readers. Also add an aria-live region for copy confirmations.

Jordan Lee: small code suggestion:
```
<button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="frame-123" class="trace-toggle">Details</button>
```

Sam Patel: CTA colors — export button currently green. Might be confused with "resolve/delete". Use blue (neutral) for export, keep red for destructive.

Arjun Gupta: I'll open a tiny PR: add aria-expanded, aria-controls, focus-visible outline, copy toast with aria-live="polite" and short-link endpoint. I'll also stub CSV sanitization flag.

Maya Chen: I'll update the mock: collapsed groups, new header copy, copy button label, and small spacing tweaks. I'll add a mobile width variant (stack frames above metadata instead of side-by-side).

Lila Park: For logs export, ops wants a checkbox "Include headers & sensitive fields" with warning tooltip. Keep unchecked by default.

Sam Patel: Thanks — can we get final sign-off by EOD Friday? :calendar:

Arjun Gupta: on it, aiming for a PR by tomorrow morning.

Maya Chen: will drop updated frames in the figma link and ping here when done.

deploy-bot: Deployment to staging scheduled: pipeline/2345 started by @arjun — logs: <https://ci.internal/repo/pipelines/2345|pipeline/2345>.

Sam Patel: Awesome, thanks everyone :sparkles:
